label: Shaving Butterfly
prompt: ONE NEW independent Nature artwork for SHAVETAIL COPSE. Our OWN accepted blue-tit reference supplies ONLY dry coloured-pencil SHARPENER-SHAVING construction, radial cut wood grain and narrow painted rims; never copy its bird/twig/pose. Make the described different whole natural subject from a FEW BROAD thin pale honey/ivory WOOD SHAVING FANS and brittle curled cone sections. Warm RAW WOOD faces with radially cut grain remain broad, color concentrated only in narrow jagged SERRATED PAINTED OUTER RIMS (cool teal/turquoise, cobalt, some forest green). Clear thin physical shaving thickness, few overlapping broad fan pieces and open curls, restrained macro miniature photography with neutral gentle light. At85px it must read as pencil-sharpener shavings with lacquer remnant edges, not fine tangled woodwool/excelsior, feathers/parallel barbs/real fur, corrugated cardboard, folded coloured paper/origami, wood intarsia/inlay, orange peel, dry pasta, satin/cloth, clay/resin/plush or a natural animal decorated with shavings. Every body/plant part is the shaving construction, tiny dark carbon-chip features permitted. Whole subject centered in CENTRAL66percent SQUARE width/height with at least15percent true TRANSPARENT alpha outer margin; all anatomy/leaf/wing/ear/tail tips fully in frame and open gaps genuinely empty. No whole pencils, sharpeners/writingtools, tool piles, paper/backing rectangle, plates/plaque/pedestal, floor/cast shadow, glow/halo, unrelated props, labels/text/numbers/branding, clocks/dates/battery/UI or mockup. Original artistic pencil-shaving sculpture interpretation, no authentic handmade-object claim. ONE whole recognizable natural BUTTERFLY with FOUR distinct broad spread wings, each made from ONE large rounded wood-shaving fan with jagged cobalt/teal painted outside rim and warm pale radial woodgrain face. Upper pair larger, lower pair smaller with gentle scalloped shape; not a single bowtie/ribbon or paper butterfly. Narrow body one softly coiled rawwood shaving strip, tiny dark carbon eye, TWO thin curled wood-shaving antennae with curved ends and SIX short coherent legs in3pairs. Natural butterfly silhouette and physical curled shaving depth, no realistic membrane/feathers. All four wing edges, both antennae and all leg ends whole; background empty.
processing: Uniform whole-original containment within1100px on1200px transparent square. No crop, recolour, code alpha cleanup or creative pixel edits.
